_about: Default ICP: sales leaders, AEs and SEs at 20-200 person companies. Keys starting with _ are notes and are not sent.
_location: To limit by HQ country, add: "company_location_search": {"include": ["India"]} — values must match Prospeo's dashboard / Search Suggestions API exactly.
_industry: To limit by industry, add "company_industry": {"include": [...]} using values from prospeo.io/api-docs/enum-industries or the dashboard's Search API export.
